masterPolicy: All master/raw images are byte-identical native tool outputs. No painting, recoloring, cropping, resizing or alpha cleanup. White/black images are QA composites only.
speciesScaleContract: Coordinator accepted the complete mounted silhouette at 52 logical pixels. Idle cap top y56 to mean near-side hind/fore wolf sole y961.5 gives 905.5 native pixels. One locked 52/905.5 scale applies to all full canvases. The actual idle visible width 57.254555 logical was explicitly accepted without forcing the preliminary 60 lower bound. identityContract: One bare-faced, dark-eyed rider with tan skin, long black braid and short face-framing hair, brown stitched fur-edged cap, small gold drop earring, cream/tan laced tunic, blue-gray near shoulder plate in idle, brown bracers and cross-body leather strap, dark trousers and tall brown boots. Seated on a stocky gray-brown wolf with cream cheek/chest fur, pointed ears, amber-brown eyes, large paws and a hanging bushy tail. Rope chest harness and rust-red-bordered saddle blanket remain distinct from wolf fur. Both hands hold the same short wooden-shaft spear with a steel leaf/triangular point aimed upper-right. Near bare hand is the rear grip at screen-left/lower shaft; far hand has a pale cloth wrap at the forward screen-right grip. A small plain round brown side shield is behind the forward forearm. No sword, bow, antlers or mount armor.
symbolContract: No faction emblem on the plain round brown shield. Keep the small pale gray angular border marks on the rust-edged saddle blanket as observed decorative marks, without inventing runic meaning. Gold drop earring and chest tie knot are costume details, not heraldry.
